patterns.name: Unrestricted Mint in Cosmos SDK
patterns.description: Token minting without proper authority check in Cosmos SDK module
patterns.recommendation: Restrict minting to governance or authorized module accounts

patterns.name: Admin Can Modify Parameters
patterns.description: Module parameters can be changed by single admin without governance
patterns.recommendation: Parameter changes should go through governance proposals

patterns.name: Emergency Fund Withdrawal
patterns.description: Function that drains module account funds to admin
patterns.recommendation: Remove arbitrary fund withdrawal or require multi-sig governance

patterns.name: Hidden Token Burn
patterns.description: Admin can burn tokens from any user account
patterns.recommendation: Only allow users to burn their own tokens

patterns.name: Upgradeable Without Governance
patterns.description: Module upgrade handler without governance approval
patterns.recommendation: All upgrades should go through on-chain governance

patterns.name: Hardcoded Admin Address
patterns.description: Admin address hardcoded in source code
patterns.recommendation: Use governance-controlled admin addresses, not hardcoded ones

patterns.name: Unsafe Exec in Module
patterns.description: Module executes arbitrary messages without validation

patterns.name: Bypass Auth Module
patterns.description: Directly accessing accounts bypassing the auth module
patterns.recommendation: Always use proper auth module for account operations

patterns.name: Hidden HTTP/gRPC Endpoint
patterns.description: Undocumented API endpoint that could provide backdoor access
patterns.recommendation: Document all API endpoints and remove debug/admin routes in production

patterns.name: Unsafe Deserialization
patterns.recommendation: Always validate deserialized data and handle errors

patterns.name: Panic in Handler
patterns.description: Panic in message handler can halt the chain
patterns.recommendation: Use error returns instead of panic in handlers

patterns.name: Integer Overflow
patterns.recommendation: Use SDK's safe math functions and check for overflow

patterns.name: Missing Error Handling
patterns.description: Ignoring error return values from critical operations

patterns.name: Non-Deterministic Code
patterns.description: Using maps without sorting or random in consensus code causes chain halt
patterns.recommendation: Sort map iterations and never use randomness in consensus code

patterns.name: Goroutine in Handler
patterns.description: Spawning goroutines in message handlers causes non-determinism
patterns.recommendation: Never use goroutines in consensus-critical code paths
